exposure: acute revascularization therapy (intravenous thrombolysis and mechanical thrombectomy)
cohort: Women aged 15-49 years hospitalized in France for ischemic stroke between 2012 and 2018, including those who were pregnant or up to 6 weeks post-partum, and their non-pregnant counterparts.
finding: Pregnant/post-partum women with ischemic stroke received acute revascularization therapy at a rate similar to their non-pregnant counterparts and showed no significant differences in characteristics, survival, or risk of recurrent events.
